methodologyNotes: Roster covers twelve residential-to-light-commercial wood chippers spanning 14-15A electric top-hopper units to 7-9.5HP/301cc gas-powered 3 in. chipper-shredders, verified 2026-08-09 against manufacturer/brand pages (WEN, PowerSmart, Patriot Products, DK2/Detail K2, Champion Power Equipment, Earthquake/Ardisam, YARDMAX, SuperHandy, GreatCircleUSA) and major retailers (Amazon, Home Depot, Lowe's, Walmart, Zoro, Farm & Fleet); accessedAt 2026-08-09 throughout. specs values are joined into scalar strings wherever a source expresses more than one figure (e.g. Patriot's differing branch vs. leaf reduction ratios, DK2's separate side-chute vs. top-hopper capacities). Fields are left null, not guessed, wherever no fetched source stated a number: DK2 OPC503's reduction ratio, Earthquake K33's and Tazz K42's shipping weight/bag capacity, and BILT HARD's exact model SKU and reduction ratio were not documented on any page reachable during research. One adversarial correction was made to the seed list: "Champion 200937" does not exist as a Champion Power Equipment product (no listing on championpowerequipment.com, Amazon, Zoro, or any retailer under that model number); the seed was replaced with Champion's actual current 3 in. gas chipper-shredder, model 200905 (224cc engine), the closest and most commonly retailed match to the intended product class. PowerSmart PS10's max-branch-diameter figure varies across the manufacturer's own channels (1.6 in. on Lowe's, 1.625 in. elsewhere, 1.75-1.77 in. on Best Buy/Amazon/FactoryPure listings); 1.75 in. is used as the figure appearing most consistently across current retail listings, with the discrepancy noted in that product's provenance. Prices are the clearest current manufacturer or authorized-retailer figure found; where list price and street/sale price diverge materially (PowerSmart, Champion, BILT HARD), priceNote records both.
